comments.author: kiester kid
comments.body_html:
Hey, this is super cool! Never seen a mod concept like this before, very neat to mess around with.

Seeing this made me wonder how realistic it would be to implement some functionality that would make it into a gameplay tool kind of like the Spy’s Invis Watch from TF2? Where you could have a meter that depletes with usage (maybe 12-15 seconds?) and recharges in downtime, and could use it to slip past some enemies invisibly and silently and get behind them for a surprise attack?

I don’t mean to be demanding - this is really well done as-is!

comments.author: MrDoesnt
comments.body_html:
The UI for that and most of the functionality is already done in another mod called ATs Nanosuit. Just would need to make it work with invisibility but I think putting the two together would be a great thing.

If you wanted to implement that, you’d also need to proactively wipe the enemy list from the memory of all bots every time you press the button, but that’s not a lot of coding. I have no plans to include a HUD with this addon.
